thread:
elaine: Quick heads-up — we've published a small handbook update to the 'Time Off & Leaves' section and kicked off a mandatory 15‑minute compliance micro-training for all full-time staff. Please complete by end of next Friday. Link: https://handbook.redwood.company/time-off-updates 

elaine: Training is short (video + 3 Qs). Completion will be tracked in the training tracker. If you manage contractors or contractors on bench, mention them here and we'll mark the assignment separately. :memo:

sophia: Thanks! Is this required for managers too? Will it be tied to the performance cycle sign-off?

elaine: Yes to managers — completion is required. It won't gate performance reviews but managers should finish before their next 1:1 review window. We will surface completion flags to managers in the tracker.

priya: Can managers export a CSV of their team's completions? I need it for the org health report.

elaine: Yes — we'll publish an export from the tracker. I'll drop the CSV to the managers channel on Monday.

james: Quick Q — contractors who are on 1099 but have Redwood accounts: do we include them?

elaine: Good question. Contractors with company accounts should get the training invite; contractors without accounts do not. If you have a contractor who needs access temporarily, ping me and we'll provision a training-only account for up to 2 weeks.

mike: Is there an opt-out for folks who completed a similar course last quarter elsewhere?

elaine: If you completed an equivalent compliance course in the last 3 months, email people-ops@redwood.com with the cert and we'll mark you exempt. Use subject: "Training Exemption — [your name]".

hr-bot: Automated assignment: 237 employees assigned to "Time Off — Microtraining". Due: 2025-09-12. Tracker URL: https://docs.redwood.company/training-tracker (updated at 2025-09-05 13:01 UTC) :bell:

priya: Thanks — can you include manager email column in the CSV export? saves me time.

elaine: Yep, manager email + team + completion timestamp will be in the export. Also adding a column for exemption notes.

james: If someone misses the deadline, what's the penalty?

elaine: No punitive action. We'll send reminders at 3 days left and 48 hours left. Missed by more than 2 weeks = manager follow-up and a flagged note in the HR dashboard. We'll be reasonable — escalation is last resort.

sophia: Will there be a short changelog for the handbook entry? I can include a blurb in the manager weekly digest.

elaine: Yes — changelog is in the handbook page (bottom). Copy for digest: "Updated Time Off policy clarifications + mandatory micro-training for staff and managers. Completion tracked via training tracker; deadline 2025-09-12." Feel free to trim.

priya: Awesome, thanks all. If you want me to run the CSV filter for the org health report, ping me after Monday's export.

elaine: Will do. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
